I have low self-esteem. How I can improve that?
</message>
output: It makes me feel stuck and like I’m not good enough, as if I’m always waiting for someone else to tell me I’m okay. I fear that if I don’t change this, I’ll keep pushing people away or settling for less than I deserve. At the same time, I regret not believing in my own abilities sooner, wondering what could have been if I’d trusted myself more.
